description: Cross-session (database vs. query) protocols for the place-disjoint (pd2026) full-key evaluation. Per-sequence 416D keys are dumped by scripts/_pd_dump_keys.py (field emb416: deployed two-pass B3 embedding, L2-normalized; identical pipeline to scripts/_pd_branch_fusion.nsd_embedding_pd). Evaluation is scripts/evaluate_cross_session.py (torch-free host): cosine top-k over the concatenated DB, success if any top-k DB pose lies within the threshold; queries with no DB pose within the threshold are excluded from the recall denominator and reported as frac_no_match. Driver: scripts/_pd_xsession_eval.py.

key_dump.gpu_command: docker exec -e PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1 -w /workspace/Neural-Spectral-Codec ring_baseline python3 scripts/_pd_dump_keys.py --variant {variant} --seed {seed} --seqs {sensor}/{seq}

nclt_0204_0317.note: RING/RING++ convention: database 2012-02-04 sampled every 20 m, query 2012-03-17 every 5 m
